$comment: Single source for Ben's resume. build.mjs renders resume.pdf (site-styled) and resume.docx (standard fonts) from this file. Every claim here is from Ben's own resume or confirmed by Ben — keep it that way.
summary: Senior software engineer working in applied AI, with 6+ years building production systems across TypeScript, React/Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Python and event-driven architecture. At Culture Amp I work directly on Coach, the company's agentic AI system, where I prototyped and shipped a human-in-the-loop pattern for AI-written content that four product domains have adopted. Strong end-to-end operator, from product ambiguity through technical design, implementation, release and iteration, and I build the harnesses and tooling that help engineering teams work well with AI.

work.stack: LangChain, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Python, Kafka

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI)
highlights: Work directly on Coach, Culture Amp's agentic AI system.

Building an agent harness for my team that encodes our ways of working with AI: skills, scripts and deterministic checks for planning, sharing plans, dispatching work and reviewing it, plus trace capture so the harness itself keeps improving. Built for Claude Code Enterprise and other tools, and adopted by my team with good feedback.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Prototyped, wrote the RFC for, and built and shipped most of Coach's human-in-the-loop pattern, which lets the agent write content such as reviews, feedback and conversation topics with guaranteed, audited human approval. Iterated on the pattern as it was adopted; four product domains use it so far.
Delivered complex enterprise AI product features in a SaaS environment, working through ambiguous requirements with product, design and engineering to ship production-ready outcomes.
Independently owned implementation across frontend, backend, infrastructure and event-driven architecture, so the team could adjust priorities quickly without heavy cross-team handoffs.
Led performance improvements for early-access features ahead of GA release: identified query bottlenecks, executed critical fixes and coordinated supporting work across the team.
Helped drive engineering adoption of AI-assisted development, a stated company priority, producing practical tutorials and tooling that improved confidence, repeatability and delivery speed.

roles.title: Software Engineer / Product Lead
highlights: Identified and implemented improvements to the feedback and issue pipeline, reducing time to resolution by ~40%.
Eliminated security vulnerabilities by driving key upgrades, including major version upgrades of Ruby and Rails in the core backend service.
Reduced local development startup time by ~30% through targeted dependency pruning, with faster CI/CD pipelines as a secondary gain.

roles.title: Junior to Mid Software Engineer
highlights: Promoted from junior to mid-level within 6 months on delivery quality and growing autonomy.
Migrated legacy codebases from Material-UI to Tailwind with zero production issues.

roles.title: Freelance Developer
highlights: Completed a 6-month coding intensive at Coder Academy (MERN stack, Ruby on Rails) after teaching myself Python through structured online courses in 2018.
Took on freelance client work, including website design and build, while based in Japan.

Contracted with a pre-launch startup: owned the testing strategy for its pre-release application, catching critical security and scalability issues before launch, and rebuilt chat, notifications and search from a legacy jQuery app in React, making them web-native and mobile-friendly.

roles.title: Guide to Program Coordinator
highlights: Progressed from guide to Program Coordinator across multiple organisations over eight years, coordinating teams delivering outdoor education and adventure programs.
Managed program logistics, participant safety and team coordination across multi-day programs with external stakeholders, requiring constant risk assessment and real-time decision-making.
